name: FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc.
summary: FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber components in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company operates through Industrial Materials, Fabric Processing Products, Sporting Goods, and Other segments. The company manufactures and sells industrial materials, including pneumatic control equipment, anti-vibration table and peripheral equipment, electrical and electronic equipment, rescue and lifesaving equipment, and carbon golf shafts. It also offers gas/water housing equipment, connection materials, and materials for speakers.
